en.name: Coconut milk, canned
en.summary: An unopened can of coconut milk keeps 2–5 years from purchase in the cupboard. Opening it changes the food: the contents then keep 4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: A sealed can keeps 2–5 years from the date of purchase in a cool, dry, dark cupboard. That long life belongs to the heat processing and the intact seal, not to the coconut — this is a low-acid food, and outside the can it is one of the more perishable things in the store cupboard. Keep cans off damp floors and away from the hob. A can that is bulging, leaking, badly rusted along a seam, or that hisses or spurts when pierced goes in the bin unopened and untasted; separation of thick cream from thin liquid inside a sound can, on the other hand, is normal.
en.fridge: The moment the can is opened it stops being a store-cupboard item and becomes a refrigerated one, with 4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Leftovers do not have to be moved out of the can for safety — the metal is not the problem — but they should be moved for flavour, because an opened can lends the milk a faint metallic edge and lets it dry at the surface. Decant into a clean covered container. It thickens and separates in the cold; stirring or gentle warming brings it back.
en.freezer: It keeps 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze the surplus on the day you open the can rather than waiting for the fridge window to run out, in small tubs or an ice cube tray so a curry can take exactly what it needs. Expect the emulsion to split on thawing into grainy fat and watery liquid — that looks alarming and is not spoilage. It comes back together with heat and a whisk, and cooks perfectly well, though it will no longer whip.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, then warm gently and whisk to bring the emulsion back, or drop frozen cubes straight into a hot curry or soup. Never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or fermented smell instead of a sweet coconut one.
A bulging, leaking or heavily dented can, or one that hisses or spurts when opened.
Pink, grey or yellow discolouration, or mould at the surface of an opened can.
Milk that has turned slimy or stringy rather than simply thick and separated.
tips: Decant leftovers into a covered container the moment the can is open.
Freeze what you will not use within the week in an ice cube tray.
Write the opening date on the container — the fridge window is short.
Rotate cans front to back so the oldest is always the next one used.

faq.q: How long does canned coconut milk last after opening?
faq.a: 4 days in a covered container at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). The years on the label belong to the sealed can only.

faq.q: Can you freeze canned coconut milk?
faq.a: Yes, 3 months at −18 °C. It splits on thawing but whisks back together when heated, so use it in cooking rather than for whipping.

faq.q: Is it safe to store leftovers in the opened can?
faq.a: It is safe, but not ideal. The can does not make the food dangerous; it does give it a metallic taste, so decant it into a covered container.

zh.name: 椰奶罐頭
zh.summary: 未開封的椰奶罐頭從購買日起算，放櫥櫃可放 2～5 年。但一開罐它就變成另一種食物：冷藏 4 °C 以下 4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 密封的罐頭放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算 2～5 年。這麼長的期限屬於商業殺菌與完好的密封罐體，不屬於椰子本身——這是低酸性食品，離開罐子之後，它是櫥櫃裡數一數二容易壞的東西。罐頭不要放在潮濕的地面，也要遠離爐台。罐身膨脹、滲漏、接縫嚴重鏽蝕，或打開時有洩氣聲、噴汁的，請不要打開、不要試吃，直接丟掉；反過來說，完好的罐頭裡濃厚椰漿與稀薄汁液分層，是正常現象。
zh.fridge: 一開罐，它就從常溫食品變成冷藏食品：4 °C 以下 4 天。就安全而言，剩下的不一定要倒出罐子——金屬本身不是問題——但為了味道應該倒出來，因為開過的罐子會讓椰奶帶一點金屬味，表面也容易乾掉。請換到乾淨的加蓋容器。低溫下它會變稠、分層，攪一攪或稍微加熱就會回來。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下可放 3 個月。請在開罐當天就把用不完的冷凍起來，不要等冷藏期快到才處理；分成小盒或倒進製冰盒，煮咖哩時要多少拿多少。解凍後乳化會崩解，油脂結成顆粒、水分跑出來——看起來很嚇人，但那不是壞掉。加熱後打一打就會回來，入菜完全沒問題，只是打不發了。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，再小火加熱並攪勻讓乳化回復；也可以把冷凍方塊直接丟進滾燙的咖哩或湯裡。不要放在室溫退冰。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有發酵味，而不是椰子的甜香。
罐身膨脹、滲漏或嚴重凹陷，或打開時洩氣、噴汁。
出現粉紅、灰色或泛黃，或開罐後表面長霉。
椰奶變得黏滑牽絲，而不只是「濃稠且分層」。
tips: 一開罐就把剩料換到加蓋容器。
這一週用不完的，當天就倒進製冰盒冷凍。
在容器上寫開罐日期，冷藏的時間比想像中短。
罐頭由前往後輪替，永遠先用最舊的那一罐。

faq.q: 椰奶罐頭開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 換到加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下 4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。標示上那幾年只屬於未開封的罐頭。
可以，−18 °C 下 3 個月。解凍會分離，但加熱攪勻就會回來，適合入菜、不適合打發。

faq.q: 剩下的可以留在開過的罐子裡嗎？
faq.a: 安全上可以，但不理想。罐子不會讓食物變危險，卻會讓它帶金屬味，還是換到加蓋容器比較好。
